column1: # Traditional forms the build script (scripts/build-word-lists.js) gets wrong, put right by hand.
# The script takes a listed word's traditional form from the dictionary entry it matches.
# Where CC-CEDICT spells the same word two ways (那裡 and 那裏, 諮詢 and 咨詢), it can pick a
# variant that is not Taiwan's standard form, and the HSK 3.0 source, which has a row for
# each CC-CEDICT entry, can list one word twice, once in each spelling (那里 as 那裡 and as
# 那裏, each with its own cards). Traditional in the app means Taiwan's standard forms
# (CLAUDE.md), so these are put right. Found on 2026-11-11 by comparing every HSK word with
# the dictionary's other spellings of the same word and with the TOCFL list (Taiwan's own),
# then checked against Taiwan's Ministry of Education dictionary (重編國語辭典修訂本, read
# locally, never copied here: local/README.md): the form meant is the one it has as a word
# where the other is missing or "a variant of" it (胷, 鮮艷, 身份, 想象, 凶殘 over 兇殘);
# where it gives both as equals ("也作": 了解 and 瞭解, 彙報 and 匯報), the one kept is
# Claude's choice. Not changed: 账 alone stays 賬 (the ministry has both; CC-CEDICT's 帳
# means only "curtain; tent"), nor 計劃 and 倒霉 (both forms equal at the ministry).
# Columns: list ("hsk" is both HSK lists), simplified, reading, form the script picks, form meant, why.
# The script stops if a line no longer changes anything, so a stale line is noticed.
# The app reads this file too (src/readingFixes.js): a device that added one of these
# words before the correction has it renamed to the form meant at its next start.
# So never remove a line that has been published, even once the lists are right.
